test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which 19-year-old wrestler became the first Indian wrestler to win a silver medal at World Wrestling Championship in October 2021 in the 57 kg weight category?
solution:
The correct option is __**Anshu Malik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anshu Malik** won the silver medal in the** 2021 World Wrestling Championship** held in** Oslo, Norway.**
 
• Anshu Malik competes in the Women's 57kg weight category.
 
• **Other medals won by her are as follows:**
 
 
• ​ won **G****old** in the 60 kg category of the **Cadet Wrestling Championships**.
 
• won a **Bronze medal **in the 57 kg event at the **2020 Asian Wrestling Championship** held in **New Delhi, India.**
 
• won the **Silver** medal in the 57 kg event at the **Individual Wrestling World Cup** held in **Belgrade, Serbia.**
 
• In **Asian Wrestling Championships 2021**, Malik bagged **Gold Medal.**
 
• In April 2022, she won one of the **Bronze medals **in the 57 kg event at the **2022 Asian Wrestling Championships** held in **Ulaanbaatar.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​​India won **14 medals** including **seven gold** at the Cadet World Wrestling Championships. Five of the seven gold medals were won by female wrestlers.
 
• **Suraj Vashisht** became the first Indian Greco-Roman wrestler after 32 years to win a gold at the event.
 
• Ritika and Priya were the first freestyle gold medalists for India at the competition this year, as they clinched the top prize in the 43 kg and 73 kg categories.
 
• India has won 4 gold,3 silver, and 3 bronze medals in Commonwealth Games 2022, England.
